semiconductor_relevance: High — International Facility Engineering specializes in creating manufacturing environments specifically for the semiconductor and high-tech industries.
summary: International Facility Engineering (IFE) provides comprehensive engineering solutions for the semiconductor sector, focusing on cleanroom construction, facility upgrades, and process systems support. Their end-to-end services enhance operational efficiency and sustainability throughout the facility lifecycle.

regional_presence.India: IFE is actively participating in SEMICON India 2026, showcasing its commitment to the semiconductor ecosystem.
